# Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh from 'lazysubmodules verify -h'; do not edit.

Usage: lazysubmodules verify [<name>...] [--signatures]

Compare the lock commit, the gitlink in the HEAD commit of the superproject
and the submodule HEAD. For tags and tag patterns, also check that the
locked tag still resolves to the locked commit. Every failed check is
printed, and the exit status is 4 when any check fails. Without names,
every managed submodule is verified.

Options:
  --signatures  also verify the signature of the locked tag or commit
